title: MK Monarch acknowledged

tellings.quote:
My friend Emma has a show called
Imagination Podcast that was on YouTube
about MK Monarch, which link I sent you
has been acknowledged.

plain: MK Monarch, said by those who talk about it to be a secret US mind-control programme, has been officially acknowledged, according to a guest named Kurt Metzger. He tells Michels that his friend Emma made a show about it called Imagination Podcast on YouTube, and that he sent Michels a link showing the acknowledgement. He does not say who acknowledged it or how.
